policy: Each damage stage edits only its immediately preceding source image. Preserve genuine alpha transparency and fixed canvas registration.

stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production spacecraft sprite for the top-down space game Vexed Mirror. Create an ORIGINAL ORION SCOUT / interceptor, a distinct small civilian-capable scout belonging to a cohesive Orion fleet. Straight orthographic overhead dorsal view, ship bow points exactly UP, flat camera with no perspective tilt. A compact split-prong arrowhead hull with short swept side fins, dark oxidized emerald metal armor, subdued aged copper structural ribs, small luminous teal engine panels at the bottom rear and a few tiny amber navigation lamps. Realistic detailed 3D-rendered spacecraft miniature, crisp readable hull panels, restrained shading from upper left, consistent with classic Star Trek inspired 2D game ship sprites, no Federation saucer and no Klingon Bird-of-Prey silhouette. Intact pristine functional hull. Center one entire ship on a square 1024x1024 canvas, bow near y=90, stern near y=930, outermost fins between x=170 and x=854. Keep comfortable transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the physical ship, including gaps between structures. No stars, black rectangle, space background, shadow plane, smoke, exhaust plume, glowing halo, lens flare, loose debris, text, insignia, numbers, labels or border. All visible illumination must be physically attached panels; game adds animated lamps and engine effects. One ship only, no collage or sprite sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied intact ORION SCOUT spacecraft sprite. Create its LIGHT DAMAGE stage by editing THIS EXACT IMAGE. A jagged notch torn from the port rear fin, two penetrating ruptures in the port forward prong and starboard mid-hull, cracked copper ribs. About 10-15 percent of surface plating visibly damaged, with physically torn and missing metal, exposed dark deck ribs and black scorch around each breach. Missing exterior hull areas and holes must be real alpha transparency. Keep most of the ship intact and operational. INVARIANTS: exactly the same square canvas, framing, overhead camera, ship position, orientation, scale, silhouette coordinates of every surviving part, same copper and emerald materials, same small teal engines and amber lamps. Surviving original pixels outside the few localized damaged areas should remain unchanged; do not repaint or redesign the ship. Do not zoom, crop, shift, rotate, stretch, recenter or shrink it. Transparent margins remain transparent. No background, stars, grey/black matte, checkerboard, shadow plane, external glow, fire, smoke, drifting debris, text or markings. No collage. The game adds animated fire, sparks and flying pieces. Return one single aligned transparent RGBA sprite.
